page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, set full width. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. No margin notes. Catchword "reus" at the right foot, signature mark "Q" at the left foot.

main_text.p: tibus ac totidem succedentibus. Id hoc modo fit. Senatus ea pars, quæ magistratu abit, quatuor viros eligit singulos è singulis civitatis regionibus, ( hæ quatuor omnino sunt ) honestissimos & gravissimos quosque ex omni populo, nulla alia tum potestate publica præditos. Hi quatuor electi totidem aliis, quibus expletum biennium est, suffecti, cæteris, qui annum in munere fuere, adduntur. Cuncti hi statim ad VIII Calend. Martij ex sui medio Seniorem designant, quem OLDERMANNUM vocant, & duos Fisci magistros, Die Bußherren dictos, fiscelli scilicet numarii curam habentes, omnes in his officiis annuos: præter quos reliqui quinque societatis judices, Die Gildtrichters/ nuncupantur. Senior, in collegio actor præcipuus, velut advocatus Reip. in tuendo stapulæ jure, de quo dixi supra, ejusque custos ac vindex, si quem contra id delinquere deprehendit, eum multam poscit, tergiversantem apud duum-viros fiscales postulat, aut ad totum collegium rem defert: sententiam pronunciatam ipse exequitur, nisi

page.notes: The "Bußherren" and "Gildtrichters" lines are set in black letter; the readings are as seen, with the long s rendered as plain s. The mark between "hæ" and "quatuor" on the printed line is a stray artefact and is not transcribed. The "/" after "Gildtrichters" is copied as printed. The small capitals in "OLDERMANNUM" are given in capitals; "vocant" is plain in the print. Running head, page number and catchword are read directly from the scan.
